regime_context: The detector shows a broad rotation (8/16 themes eligible) with no single dominant narrative — Oil & Gas leads on rank but is crowded and 'mixed' Hurst, while Gold is a close challenger with thin breadth. Momentum rank is a focus lens (rank-IC ~0); the only validated edge here is the absolute-trend gate, which is ON (gate_helps=true), so trend-eligible themes have stayed-power protection but no return forecast. No per-theme view is strongly supported; leans below are expressed only as humble, falsifiable conditionals.
emerging_watch: Gold Miners (ca_gold) — watching whether its durability_bar climbs above ~0.55 AND breadth rises above ~0.4 together; until both improve, the challenger label is display-only. If breadth stays below 0.3 while Oil & Gas keeps durability above 0.6, the watch retires as a confirmed non-handoff.

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are eligible with the highest durability_bar (0.59) among non-crowded, scorable themes and a 'trend' Hurst tag — the one leg with a validated risk-control history (absolute-trend gate). Rank is mid but this is explicitly not a return forecast; the trend-gate merely says participation carries shallower drawdown risk than non-eligible themes.
theses.dissent: Breadth is only 0.143 — the trend is very narrow, likely carried by one or two names, so the theme can stall without notice; macro backdrop is 75% unscheduled news, which hits rate-sensitive banks hard.

falsifier.text: ZEB.TO closes below its 50-day average while the S&P/TSX stays flat or rises, before the check-by date.

theses.subject: Technology
theses.thesis: Technology is the most crowded scorable theme (crowding_z=1.25) with a 'mixed' Hurst tag and barely-positive rank. Crowding is a size-down caution only, never a fade — but as a lean, avoiding participation is the honest expression of that caution, especially with broad rotation (frac=0.5) offering cleaner trend-eligible alternatives.
evidence: guardrails: crowding is a size-down caution, never a fade
theses.dissent: Tech has breadth=0.70 — the most cohesive participation among all themes — and mixed Hurst does not mean trend failure; inflow-driven momentum can persist longer than caution suggests.

falsifier.text: XIT.TO makes a new 60-day high on above-average volume while the S&P/TSX does not, before the check-by date.
